source: committed JSONL; independently verified frozen analyzer output
units: memory bytes; CPU percent of one core; slopes MiB/hour
boundaries: Elapsed-hour buckets start at the original window start, not civil-hour boundaries.
CPU intervals crossing a bucket are split proportionally, assuming uniform CPU within that minute.
Original whole minute intervals remain separately in cpu-intervals.json; split parts are not new samples.
Memory quantiles use observed endpoints; first and end are actual endpoints, not interpolation.
Slot24 is a terminal single endpoint with tiny deadline spill; it is not a complete 25th hour.
Cumulative state/hourly files are retained privately and are not used as single-hour statistics.
Frozen analyzer terminal_endpoint_only=false at slot24 because there is a tiny CPU spill; terminal_memory_endpoint explicitly identifies its single memory endpoint. Neither is a complete hour.
